title: Nova: Return of the Rings #1
desc:
THE RINGS OF POWER RETURN TO EARTH!

Deemed too dangerous to remain on Earth, the TEN RINGS OF POWER were jettisoned off into the depths space — but have since broken containment!

Now one of the rings returns to Earth with a brand-new bearer hellbent on getting his hands on the sentient supercomputer, WORLDMIND, as his first step of galactic domination!

His target?

None other than SAM ALEXANDER, A.K.A. NOVA!

Don't miss out on this HISPANIC HERITAGE MONTH celebration!
